findings.claim: The attachment tile is rendered as an interactive tooltip/dialog trigger using a plain div without semantic button role or keyboard focus handling.
findings.evidence: The hunk replaces the previous `<div ... role="button" ... aria-label=...>` inside `<TooltipTrigger asChild>` with `<TooltipTrigger render={<div ... id="attachment-tile" aria-label=... />}>`, leaving the rendered interactive element as a non-semantic div; this conflicts with the `accessibility-basics` warning constraint requiring new UI components to have aria-label or semantic HTML.
findings.suggested_fix: Render a real `button`/`Button` for the trigger, or ensure the rendered div receives `role="button"`, `tabIndex={0}`, and keyboard activation support compatible with Base UI.
